017package org.apache.juneau;
018
019import static java.util.stream.Collectors.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.ThrowableUtils.*;
021import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
022
023import java.io.*;
024import java.net.*;
025import java.util.*;
026import java.util.stream.*;
027
028import org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.*;
029import org.junit.jupiter.api.*;
030
031/**
032 * Shared, marshall-free test utilities common to Juneau test modules.
033 *
034 * <p>
035 * Provides the stable pure-JDK/commons subset of the per-module {@code TestUtils} classes: exception-message
036 * assertions, equality helpers, stream/reader factories, locale/timezone toggles, and URL construction.  Module-level
037 * {@code TestUtils} classes extend this base and add their own marshall-bound helpers (e.g. {@code assertJson},
038 * {@code json}, {@code validateXml}).
039 *
040 * <p>
041 * This class lives in the {@code juneau-test-utils} module, which depends only on {@code juneau-commons} and JUnit, so
042 * it never introduces a {@code juneau-marshall} dependency onto its consumers.
043 */
044@SuppressWarnings({
045   "java:S5960" // test-support utility shipped as main source; assertions are intentional
046})
047public abstract class BasicTestUtils extends Shorts {
048
049   private static final ThreadLocal<TimeZone> SYSTEM_TIME_ZONE = new ThreadLocal<>();
050
051   /** Holds the previous default locale while a test overrides it via {@link #setLocale(Locale)}. */
052   public static final ThreadLocal<Locale> SYSTEM_LOCALE = new ThreadLocal<>();
053
054   /**
055    * Asserts that all the specified values are equal to the first value.
056    *
057    * @param values The values to compare.  Element 0 is the expected value.
058    */
059   public static void assertEqualsAll(Object...values) {
060      for (var i = 1; i < values.length; i++) {
061         assertEquals(values[0], values[i], fs("Elements at index %1$s and %2$s did not match. %1$s=%3$s, %2$s=%4$s", 0, i, r(values[0]), r(values[i])));
062      }
063   }
064
065   /**
066    * Asserts that the specified actual value does not equal any of the specified values.
067    *
068    * @param actual The actual value.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
069    * @param values The values that must not match the actual value.
070    */
071   public static void assertNotEqualsAny(Object actual, Object...values) {
072      assertNotNull(actual, "Value was null.");
073      for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
074         assertNotEquals(values[i], actual, fs("Element at index %s unexpectedly matched.  expected=%s, actual=%s", i, values[i], s(actual)));
075      }
076   }
077
078   /**
079    * Asserts that the specified executable throws an exception whose chained messages contain all the specified substrings.
080    *
081    * @param <T> The expected exception type.
082    * @param expectedType The expected exception type.
083    * @param expectedSubstrings The substrings expected in the exception message chain.
084    * @param executable The code expected to throw.
085    * @return The thrown exception.
086    */
087   public static <T extends Throwable> T assertThrowsWithMessage(Class<T> expectedType, List<String> expectedSubstrings, org.junit.jupiter.api.function.Executable executable) {
088      var exception = Assertions.assertThrows(expectedType, executable);
089      var messages = getMessages(exception);
090      expectedSubstrings.forEach(x -> assertTrue(messages.contains(x), fs("Expected message to contain: %s.\nActual:\n%s", x, messages)));
091      return exception;
092   }
093
094   /**
095    * Asserts that the specified executable throws an exception whose chained messages contain the specified substring.
096    *
097    * @param <T> The expected exception type.
098    * @param expectedType The expected exception type.
099    * @param expectedSubstring The substring expected in the exception message chain.
100    * @param executable The code expected to throw.
101    * @return The thrown exception.
102    */
103   public static <T extends Throwable> T assertThrowsWithMessage(Class<T> expectedType, String expectedSubstring, org.junit.jupiter.api.function.Executable executable) {
104      var exception = Assertions.assertThrows(expectedType, executable);
105      var messages = getMessages(exception);
106      assertTrue(messages.contains(expectedSubstring), fs("Expected message to contain: %s.\nActual:\n%s", expectedSubstring, messages));
107      return exception;
108   }
109
110   /**
111    * Collects the newline-joined message chain of the specified throwable and all its causes.
112    *
113    * @param t The throwable.
114    * @return The joined message chain.
115    */
116   protected static String getMessages(Throwable t) {
117      return Stream.iterate(t, Throwable::getCause).takeWhile(e -> e != null).map(Throwable::getMessage).collect(joining("\n"));
118   }
119
120   /**
121    * Creates an input stream from the specified string.
122    *
123    * @param in The contents of the stream.
124    * @return A new input stream.
125    */
126   public static final ByteArrayInputStream inputStream(String in) {
127      return new ByteArrayInputStream(in.getBytes());
128   }
129
130   /**
131    * Creates a reader from the specified string.
132    *
133    * @param in The contents of the reader.
134    * @return A new reader.
135    */
136   public static final StringReader reader(String in) {
137      return new StringReader(in);
138   }
139
140   /**
141    * Temporarily sets the default system locale to the specified locale.
142    *
143    * @param v The new default locale.
144    */
145   public static final void setLocale(Locale v) {
146      SYSTEM_LOCALE.set(Locale.getDefault());
147      Locale.setDefault(v);
148   }
149
150   /**
151    * Temporarily sets the default system timezone to the specified timezone ID.
152    *
153    * @param v The new default timezone ID.
154    */
155   public static final synchronized void setTimeZone(String v) {
156      SYSTEM_TIME_ZONE.set(TimeZone.getDefault());
157      TimeZone.setDefault(TimeZone.getTimeZone(v));
158   }
159
160   /**
161    * Restores the default system locale saved by {@link #setLocale(Locale)}.
162    */
163   public static final void unsetLocale() {
164      Locale.setDefault(SYSTEM_LOCALE.get());
165   }
166
167   /**
168    * Restores the default system timezone saved by {@link #setTimeZone(String)}.
169    */
170   public static final synchronized void unsetTimeZone() {
171      TimeZone.setDefault(SYSTEM_TIME_ZONE.get());
172      SYSTEM_TIME_ZONE.remove();
173   }
174
175   /**
176    * Constructs a {@link URL} object from a string.
177    *
178    * @param value The URL string.
179    * @return A new {@link URL} object.
180    */
181   public static URL url(String value) {
182      return safe(()->new URI(value).toURL());
183   }
184
185   /**
186    * Returns an empty array of the specified type.
187    *
188    * @param <T> The component type.
189    * @param t The component type.
190    * @return A new empty array of the specified type.
191    */
192   public static <T> T[] ea(Class<T> t) {
193      return CollectionUtils.array(t, 0);
194   }
195}
